title: The moment Jairus heard the words:
paragraphs:
The moment Jairus heard the words:
“Your daughter is dead.”

But Jesus said something simple:
“Don’t fear. Just believe.”

Some moments test whether we trust the report…
or the One who has the final word.
What situation in your life feels “finished” right now?
Sometimes faith is simply taking one more step.
Jairus walked to Jesus with hope.

Halfway there, the worst message came:
“Your daughter is dead.”

Faith isn’t pretending problems aren’t real.
It’s trusting that God still has the final move.

Some news tries to end your story.
Faith reminds you it isn’t over yet.
